findings.title: The Plan and Amount columns of the invoice table are far apart

location.description: The Invoices table, between the Plan column and the Amount column

findings.viewer_experience: A wide empty gap separates the plan name from its amount, so the eye has to cross it and can slip to the neighbouring row.

current.value: The Plan column ends near the middle of the table and the Amount column starts near the right edge, with a wide empty gap between them.

findings.target: Each row can be followed from its plan to its amount without losing the line.
findings.fix_direction: Bring the plan and amount closer together or give the rows a stronger guide for the eye.

closed_when.check: Look at the Invoices table: a row can be followed from plan to amount without effort.

findings.title: Two menus both say Settings and the left menu gives no title

location.description: The top bar item Settings and the left menu beside the page heading

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees a top bar with Settings marked and a second menu on the left with no heading, and has to work out how the two relate.

current.value: The left menu has no heading and the top bar item Settings is the only link to it.

findings.target: The viewer can tell at a glance that the left menu belongs to Settings.
findings.fix_direction: Show that the left menu is the Settings menu.

closed_when.check: Look at the left menu: it is clear that it is the Settings menu.
